verse.unicode: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ

transliteration.english: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t

en.bdb: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Chhant:

verse.unicode: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

transliteration.english: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||

en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verse.unicode: ਮੰਗਲ ਸਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: ma(n)gal saaj bhiaa prabh apanaa gaiaa raam ||

en.bdb: The time of rejoicing has come; I sing of my Lord God.

verse.unicode: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਵਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਚਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: abinaasee var suniaa man upajiaa chaiaa raam ||

en.bdb: I have heard of my Imperishable Husband Lord, and happiness fills my mind.

verse.unicode: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗੈ ਕਬ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਤੇ ॥

transliteration.english: man preet laagai vaddai bhaagai kab mileeaai pooran pate ||

en.bdb: My mind is in love with Him; when shall I realize my great good fortune, and meet with my Perfect Husband?

verse.unicode: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਤੇ ॥

transliteration.english: sahaje samaieeaai govi(n)dh paieeaai dheh sakhe'ee moh mate ||

en.bdb: If only I could meet the Lord of the Universe, and be automatically absorbed into Him; tell me how, O my companions!

verse.unicode: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਠਾਢੀ ਕਰਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: dhin rain Thaaddee karau sevaa prabh kavan jugatee paiaa ||

en.bdb: Day and night, I stand and serve my God; how can I attain Him?

verse.unicode: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੈਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa laih moh laR laiaa ||1||

en.bdb: Prays Nanak, have mercy on me, and attach me to the hem of Your robe, O Lord. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਭਇਆ ਸਮਾਹੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: bhiaa samaahaRaa har ratan visaahaa raam ||

en.bdb: Joy has come! I have purchased the jewel of the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: khojee khoj ladhaa har sa(n)tan paahaa raam ||

en.bdb: Searching, the seeker has found the Lord with the Saints.

verse.unicode: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੇ ਕਥਹਿ ਅਕਥ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥

transliteration.english: mile sa(n)t piaare dhiaa dhaare katheh akath beechaaro ||

en.bdb: I have met the Beloved Saints, and they have blessed me with their kindness; I contemplate the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥

transliteration.english: eik chit ik man dhiaai suaamee lai preet piaaro ||

en.bdb: With my consciousness centered, and my mind one-pointed, I meditate on my Lord and Master, with love and affection.

verse.unicode: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਾਹਾ ॥

transliteration.english: kar joR prabh peh kar bina(n)tee milai har jas laahaa ||

en.bdb: With my palms pressed together, I pray unto God, to bless me with the profit of the Lord's Praise.

verse.unicode: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: binava(n)t naanak dhaas teraa meraa prabh agam athaahaa ||2||

en.bdb: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave. My God is inaccessible and unfathomable. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਸਾਹਾ ਅਟਲੁ ਗਣਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੰਜੋਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: saahaa aTal ganiaa pooran sa(n)jogo raam ||

en.bdb: The date for my wedding is set, and cannot be changed; my union with the Lord is perfect.

verse.unicode: ਸੁਖਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਭਇਆ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਜੋਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: sukheh samooh bhiaa giaa vijogo raam ||

en.bdb: I am totally at peace, and my separation from Him has ended.

verse.unicode: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਏ ਬਣੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਜਾਞੀਆਂ ॥

transliteration.english: mil sa(n)t aae prabh dhiaae bane acharaj jaan(j)eeaa(n) ||

en.bdb: The Saints meet and come together, and meditate on God; they form a wondrous wedding party.

verse.unicode: ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਢੋਏ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਮਾਞੀਆ ॥

transliteration.english: mil ikatr hoe sahaj ddoe man preet upajee maan(j)eeaa ||

en.bdb: Gathering together, they arrive with poise and grace, and love fills the minds of the bride's family.

verse.unicode: ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੋ ॥

transliteration.english: mil jot jotee ot potee har naam sabh ras bhogo ||

en.bdb: Her light blends with His Light, through and through, and everyone enjoys the Nectar of the Lord's Name.

verse.unicode: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਸੰਤਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੋ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: binava(n)t naanak sabh sa(n)t melee prabh karan kaaran jogo ||3||

en.bdb: Prays Nanak, the Saints have totally united me with God, the All-powerful Cause of causes. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਭਵਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਸਭਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: bhavan suhaavaRaa dharat sabhaagee raam ||

en.bdb: Beautiful is my home, and beauteous is the earth.

verse.unicode: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਅੜਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: prabh ghar aaiaRaa gur charanee laagee raam ||

en.bdb: God has entered the home of my heart; I touch the Guru's feet.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥

transliteration.english: gur charan laagee sahaj jaagee sagal ichhaa pu(n)neeaa ||

en.bdb: Grasping the Guru's feet, I awake in peace and poise. All my desires are fulfilled.

verse.unicode: ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥

transliteration.english: meree aas pooree sa(n)t dhooree har mile ka(n)t vichhu(n)niaa ||

en.bdb: My hopes are fulfilled, through the dust of the feet of the Saints. After such a long separation, I have met my Husband Lord.

verse.unicode: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਹੰ ਮਤਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥

transliteration.english: aana(n)dh anadhin vajeh vaaje aha(n) mat man kee tiaagee ||

en.bdb: Night and day, the sounds of ecstasy resound and resonate; I have forsaken my stubborn-minded intellect.

verse.unicode: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੧॥

transliteration.english: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee sa(n)tasa(n)g liv laagee ||4||1||

en.bdb: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of my Lord and Master; in the Society of the Saints, I am lovingly attuned to Him. ||4||1||
